subject: Re: MuZero hardening — April status
body:
Hi both,

Status:

- CI gate landed 03-05: tictactoe converges to perfect play in under 40 min on a fixed seed, and the test fails loudly if the learned-model rollout diverges from the reference trajectories. Already caught one regression from a dependency bump.
- Single-machine atari validation done on 3 games. Interesting knob finding for the docs: cutting simulations per move from 50 to 24 loses almost nothing on Pong but is a big hit on Ms. Pacman — planning depth matters most where the reward is sparse and delayed. Writing that up properly.
- Distributed: Paloma's fan-out work found exactly what Ivo predicted — at 300+ actors the inference batcher starves the learner. Her fix (double-buffered batching) gets learner utilization from 61% to 88%. One preemption-recovery bug remains; replay contents survive but priorities reset, which skews sampling for ~1h after restart.

On track for the May distributed run.

Rafael
